tools.name: The Long Dark
tools.rule: Every hour underground without a lit flame, everyone saves.
tools.trigger: At the end of every hour spent underground with no open flame among the party, each creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. The tier is how many hours they have gone dark, not how deep they are.
rows: 2 Exhaustion, and you hear your own name

notes.b: A new flame ends the count. It does not remove exhaustion.

cards.name: The needle gauge
cards.text:
A brass needle on a dial, and beneath it, stamped into the plate:

“WHEN IT IS LIGHT ENOUGH, IT OPENS.”
cards.dm:
